note: Pin: Spirit Walk is a 0.16 s dodge roll then 2.8 s of walking through things; the air dash is a flick. Rules: buffer = the press is carried to the dash end (0.15 s), fire = it works at once, cancel = it ends the other move.

pairs.source: an arrow cannot be drawn in the roll; the press waits
pairs.ours: the draw starts when the roll ends
the draw starts when the flick ends

pairs.source: Impaling Shot can be started in the walk
pairs.ours: the Heavy Shot hold starts at once

pairs.source: Rain of Arrows can be cast in the walk
pairs.ours: Hail Wall goes off at once

pairs.source: Primal Forces can be cast in the walk
the dodge roll interrupts a draw
pairs.ours: the draw ends with no arrow
the draw ends with no arrow
